faultClientNetwork.description: The last Chromium page is reserved for slow, interrupted and cancelled operations. CDP throttles actual transfers. Interrupted and cancelled multipart PUTs abort after observed partial progress and then explicitly abort the session for test cleanup. This does not establish unattended expiration recovery.

recovery.description: Time after each load reduction or worker restart until generator inflight count, Rabbit message count, durable outbox depth and PREPARING assets remain at or below the pre-event window p95 for ten seconds. Unrecovered events fail acceptance.

generatorPlacement: Docker bridge network with direct service DNS, one Chromium process, four pages, same VM as services; measured traffic does not use host port forwarding
startingState: Fresh project-scoped volumes, one replica of every service, warmed with the same seeded 30-second workload, then queues drained; no cache priming beyond warmup
fixtureRetention: The generator deletes its own source, variants and completion record only after verifying retrieval. This synthetic retention policy bounds disk consumption. Cleanup cost remains in service measurements and is recorded separately from observed-ready and downloadable latency. It does not validate the production seven-day lifecycle or 24-hour cleanup grace period.
syntheticAssumptions: No production traffic distribution is available. Weights are experimental, not production estimates. Arrivals use a deterministic time grid, not a Poisson process. Solid/text documents represent compressible data; seeded noise represents incompressible data and complex images. Local storage and network omit WAN/remote-storage latency. Repeated fixture bytes intentionally test repeated content without assuming deduplication.

smoke.evidence: Correctness and setup only; cannot validate p99

cohort.evidence: Run three times separately for each exact fixture COHORT to attribute resources and obtain at least1200 tail samples for rare large-file cohorts

quick.evidence: Screening only, three repeats; mixed cohort tails may be underpowered

slow.evidence: Synthetic4Mbit/s uplink16Mbit/s downlink180ms RTT per browser, CDP aggregate across all requests on that page, enabled after fixture preparation. Small fixture subset, not a high-load capacity claim

wan-multipart.evidence: Synthetic64Mbit/s uplink128Mbit/s downlink180ms RTT; sequential multipart boundary coverage, not weakest-link broadband

quick-soak.evidence: Five-minute resource-growth/cleanup screen; does not establish long-duration production leak freedom

acceptance.accounting: Every scheduled operation must have exactly one terminal record; expected faults require observed injection and explicit outcome; no undrained queue or unfinished operation
acceptance.comparison: Three matched repeats; protocol, fixture and environment hashes must match. Exact order-statistic p99 confidence intervals and at least 1000 successful samples per cohort are required. Insufficient evidence cannot accept a candidate.
acceptance.guards: Protect p95, p99, unexpected error fraction, successful files/bytes throughput, generator lag, recovery and service CPU/memory/network/storage using only measured baseline repeat spread as allowance; inspect each cohort for operation-level measures. Run-level counters cannot establish cohort resource nonregression, so isolated cohort runs are required before claiming that guarantee.
acceptance.improvement: Require p99 improvement beyond variability and uncertainty, plus lower CPU or transferred/stored bytes per success beyond variability, with every guard passing
acceptance.changes: Changes to this evaluator or frozen protocol after baseline require user agreement. Instrumentation changes require a fresh baseline.
acceptance.stop: 15 measured candidates maximum, or five consecutive unsuccessful rounds after broader investigation following two unsuccessful rounds. Infrastructure blockers stop measurements without claiming the objective.

strategy.authorizedBy: Latest user instruction delegates redesign for shorter useful benchmarks and slow internet, with no questions
strategy.screening: 120-second mixed load, three matched repeats per side; reject clear regressions, do not claim every rare cohort p99 is powered
strategy.confirmation: Only surviving focused candidates receive targeted network/fault/ramp/overload and300-second soak checks. Extend samples only for a specific unresolved decision. Original full scenarios remain available.
strategy.claims: Keep exact p99 intervals and existing guards. Underpowered cohorts remain insufficient evidence, never silently accepted. Functional reliability improvements may ship with passing correctness and measured screening nonregression while comprehensive performance objective remains unproven.
